title: There's a Hole in the Universe

scenes.voiceover: There is a hole in the universe. And it's three hundred thirty million light years wide.
scenes.mainText: THERE'S A HOLE IN THE UNIVERSE
scenes.backgroundPrompt: enormous dark sphere of nothing in a galaxy field

scenes.voiceover: In 1981, astronomers mapping the sky found a region with almost nothing inside.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: 1980s telescope survey map with black gap

scenes.voiceover: A region that size should hold about ten thousand galaxies. The Bootes Void holds around sixty.
scenes.visualConcept: count-up lands on a tiny number

scenes.voiceover: If our galaxy sat at its center, we would have believed we were completely alone in the universe.
scenes.mainText: we would have believed we were alone
scenes.visualConcept: one dim galaxy in a black frame
scenes.backgroundPrompt: single galaxy surrounded by absolute darkness

scenes.voiceover: Here's the problem. The universe isn't old enough for a void this big to form naturally.
scenes.mainText: the universe ISN'T OLD ENOUGH for this
scenes.backgroundPrompt: cosmic web with an impossible gap torn in it

scenes.voiceover: So either our physics is missing something. Or something we don't understand emptied it.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: abstract question mark of dark matter

scenes.voiceover: Astronomers call it the Great Nothing. Follow mindwired, because space is stranger than fiction.
scenes.mainText: they call it THE GREAT NOTHING
